messages:
shreya: Hey team, kicking off the security baseline thread for the new eu-west-2 GPU cluster bring-up. Focus: IAM roles, secrets handling, KMS/HSM integration, and automated policy checks. I’ll drop the draft checklist below.
matt: thanks — do we already have a preferred KMS key policy for customer-dedicated/private clusters? wondering about HSM requirement for regulated customers.
shreya: For Dedicated we want CMKs in the customer-managed KMS with key rotation enabled. For Private (on-prem/VPC) we prefer HSM-backed keys where available. Notes in the checklist.
ops-bot: quick-check: cluster-provision job triggered for eu-west-2-gpu-01 at 2026-03-18T09:12Z :white_check_mark:
eva: can we ensure the IAM role for the serving nodes is least-privileged? last time `svc/gpu-node` had s3:GetObject wide access.
shreya: Absolutely. Proposed role: `svc/gpu-node` with only kms:Decrypt (for model artifacts), s3:GetObject on specific prefixes, ec2:Describe* limited to tags. Example IAM inline policy:
```json
{"Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-models/eu-west-2/*"]}, {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-..."]}]}
```
jun: add `kms:Decrypt` only for the node pool role; the control-plane role should have `kms:DescribeKey` and administration ops perms via an admin role, not node role.
matt: what about secret rotation for API keys and model signing keys? we need automated rotation and an alert if a secret hasn’t rotated in 90d.
security-bot: secret-rotation-policy check: FAILED — `secret/redwood/eu-west-2/model-signing` last-rotated 140 days ago. Please rotate and update deployment pipeline secrets manager references. :rotating_light:
shreya: good catch. Action: rotate model-signing key, update pipeline. I'll create a follow-on runbook entry.
eva: networking: ensure cluster subnets are private with NAT for egress and security groups locked to only required egress to S3, KMS endpoints, and our metrics endpoints. No open 0.0.0.0/0 egress for nodes.
matt: mention GPU capacity/cost note: prefer a small warm pool (2-4 nodes) for p99 latency guarantees; document the expected hourly cost delta in the handoff.
shreya: Checklist (draft):
1) IAM roles: node role, control-plane role, admin role. Least privilege + explicit denies for S3 list unless needed.
2) Secrets: store in Secrets Manager (or Vault). Enforce rotation <=90 days + automated pipeline update.
3) KMS/HSM: use customer-managed CMK; require HSM for Private clusters. Set key policy to limit usage to cluster roles and security-admins.
4) Network: private subnets, restricted egress to S3/KMS, VPC endpoints for S3 + KMS where possible.
5) Policy checks: run `infra-policy-scan` and `iam-lint` as pre-handoff gates.
6) Audit: enable CloudTrail/Stackdriver with KMS encryption and retention 1y; stream logs to secure logging account.
7) Handoff: generate `provisioning-handoff.md` with key ARNs, service account ARNs, and cost delta.

Commands to validate quickly:
```
# check kms key policy
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/redwood-eu2 --policy-name default
# secret rotation status
aws secretsmanager get-rotation-status --secret-id secret/redwood/eu-west-2/model-signing
# run infra policy scans
./tools/infra-policy-scan --cluster eu-west-2-gpu-01
```
jun: +1 to adding automated `pre-handoff` job that fails the CI if any check fails. We should attach the job to the cluster repo and to the provisioning pipeline.
matt: once shreya publishes the handoff doc, ops will do a dry-run and security will sign off. timeline?
shreya: aim to publish today, do dry-run tomorrow morning. Security review by EOD tomorrow.
security-bot: note: for regulated customers require: HSM-backed CMK, customer KMS in their account, and audit logs retained 7 years — flag added to handoff template.
shreya: tagging @matt @jun @eva for handoff review. I’ll attach the provisioning-handoff.md to this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
matt: thanks — will allocate time for the dry-run and cost review.
